company_news.headline: Walmart (WMT) Launches 40,000 Acre Regenerative Agriculture Effort With General Mills And ADM
company_news.summary: Walmart (NasdaqGS:WMT), General Mills and ADM are working together on a new regenerative agriculture program. The initiative covers 40,000 Midwest wheat acres with goals tied to soil health, water quality and carbon sequestration. The collaboration is designed as a model for broader industry change across food and retail supply chains. company_news.headline: General Mills Brings the Magic of Harry Potter™ Home with New Treats from Betty Crocker and Pillsbury
company_news.summary: MINNEAPOLIS, July 23, 2026--Wizards, witches and Muggles alike can bring a little magic into their homes with new and returning Harry Potter-inspired products from Pillsbury and Betty Crocker. Arriving at retailers nationwide just in time for a season full of Harry Potter celebrations, this lineup is made for new ways to experience the beloved stories at home.
